title: Creator profile
description: The creator's profile, written by onboarding to me/profile.json. Each description below finishes the sentence 'It should be ...', and kit.config reuses it as the hint in its error messages.

version.description: the profile format number, which is 1

name.description: the name of the creator or brand, as it should appear on screen

handles.description: a group with one account name per platform, left empty for a platform you do not use

instagram.description: your Instagram account name, such as @yourname

tiktok.description: your TikTok account name, such as @yourname

youtube.description: your YouTube channel handle, such as @yourname

linkedin.description: your LinkedIn page or profile name

twitter.description: your X (Twitter) account name, such as @yourname

niche.description: a sentence on what your videos are about

credibility.description: a sentence on why people should listen to you

audience.description: a group that says who your videos are for and what they want

who.description: a sentence on who your videos are for

wants.description: a sentence on what that audience wants from you

cta.description: a group that says how your videos end: with a plain follow, or with a comment keyword

type.description: how your videos end, either follow or comment

keyword.description: the word people comment to get your offer, such as GROW, or null for a plain follow

payload.description: what you send to people who comment, or null for a plain follow

comment_platforms.description: a list of the platforms where you answer comments with your offer, such as instagram, or an empty list for a plain follow

keyword.description: the word people comment to get your offer, such as GROW, which a comment call to action needs

comment_platforms.description: a list with at least one platform where you answer comments with your offer, such as instagram, which a comment call to action needs

platforms.description: a list of the platforms you post on, chosen from instagram, tiktok, youtube, facebook, linkedin and twitter

timezone.description: your time zone as an Area/City name, such as Europe/London

additionalProperties.description: a time in 24 hour HH:MM form, such as 18:00

posting_times.description: a group with your usual posting time for each platform, in 24 hour HH:MM form such as 18:00, or an empty group if you would rather give a time with each post

colours.description: a group holding the five brand colours: canvas, ink, accent, field_dark and field_light

canvas.description: the light colour behind graphics and captions, as a hex code with six digits such as #f7f5f0

ink.description: the dark colour for text on the canvas, as a hex code with six digits such as #1d2420

accent.description: the one bright colour used for highlights, as a hex code with six digits such as #177245

field_dark.description: the dark background colour, as a hex code with six digits such as #16302b

field_light.description: the light background colour, as a hex code with six digits such as #eaf1e4

fonts.description: a group naming the display, body and mono fonts

display.description: the font for headlines and captions: the name of a font that comes with the kit, or the path of your own font file inside your me folder, such as brand/fonts/YourFont.woff2

body.description: the font for body text and small labels, named the same way as the display font

mono.description: the font for code and numbers, named the same way as the display font

logo.description: the path of your logo file inside your me folder, such as brand/logo/logo.png, or null if you have no logo

styles.description: a list of the video styles you use, chosen from ui-story and mini-me

voice_over.description: how you make a voice-over: record (you record it), elevenlabs (a stock ElevenLabs voice) or clone (a copy of your own voice, which records your consent)

image_provider.description: the tool that draws your character: manual (you paste prompts into an image tool yourself), openai, gemini or codex

hashtags.description: a group holding your base hashtags

base.description: a list of the hashtags that go on your posts (LinkedIn gets none), each starting with # and with no spaces, such as #yourtag

research.description: an optional group of research settings, left out to use the defaults

cost_cap.description: a group with the most one research run may spend on each platform, in US dollars

instagram.description: an amount in US dollars: the most one research run may spend on Instagram

tiktok.description: an amount in US dollars: the most one research run may spend on TikTok

scrape_seconds.description: a number of seconds from 10 to 1800: the longest one research run waits for Instagram, TikTok and YouTube
